entries.title: Exodus 14:1
segments: ¶And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 14:2
segments: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea: before Baal-Zephon, opposite to it, shall ye encamp by the sea.

entries.title: Exodus 14:3
segments: And Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness has hemmed them in.

entries.title: Exodus 14:4
segments: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he may pursue after them; and I will glorify myself in Pharaoh, and in all his host; and the Egyptians shall know that I am Jehovah. And they did so.

entries.title: Exodus 14:5
segments: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people had fled; and the heart of Pharaoh and of his bondmen was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from our service?

entries.title: Exodus 14:6
segments: And he yoked his chariot, and took his people with him.

entries.title: Exodus 14:7
segments: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

entries.title: Exodus 14:8
segments: And Jehovah hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel; and the children of Israel had gone out with a high hand.

entries.title: Exodus 14:9
segments: And the Egyptians pursued after them, --all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them where they had encamped by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, opposite to Baal-Zephon.

entries.title: Exodus 14:10
segments: ¶And Pharaoh approached; and the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and the children of Israel were much afraid, and cried out to Jehovah.

entries.title: Exodus 14:11
segments: And they said to Moses, Is it because there were no graves in Egypt, thou hast taken us away to die in the wilderness? why hast thou done this to us, that thou hast led us out of Egypt?

entries.title: Exodus 14:12
segments: Is not this what we told thee in Egypt, when we said, Let us alone, and we will serve the Egyptians? For [it had been] better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.

entries.title: Exodus 14:13
segments: And Moses said to the people, Fear not: stand still, and see the salvation of Jehovah, which he will work for you to-day; for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to-day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

entries.title: Exodus 14:14
segments: Jehovah will fight for you, and ye shall be still.

entries.title: Exodus 14:15
segments: ¶And Jehovah said to Moses, Why dost thou cry unto me? Speak unto the children of Israel, that they go forward.

entries.title: Exodus 14:16
segments: And thou, lift thy staff, and stretch out thy hand over the sea, and divide it; and the children of Israel shall go on dry [ground] through the midst of the sea.

entries.title: Exodus 14:17
segments: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall pursue after them; and I will glorify myself in Pharaoh and in all his host, in his chariots and in his horsemen.

entries.title: Exodus 14:18
segments: And the Egyptians shall know that I am Jehovah, when I have glorified myself in Pharaoh, in his chariots and in his horsemen.

entries.title: Exodus 14:19
segments: And the Angel of God, who went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before them, and stood behind them.

entries.title: Exodus 14:20
segments: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Israel; and was a cloud and darkness, and lit up the night; and the one did not come near the other all the night.

entries.title: Exodus 14:21
segments: ¶And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Jehovah made the sea go [back] by a strong east wind all the night, and made the sea dry [land], and the waters were divided.

entries.title: Exodus 14:22
segments: And the children of Israel went through the midst of the sea on the dry [ground]; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

entries.title: Exodus 14:23
segments: And the Egyptians pursued and came after them--all Pharaoh's horses, his chariots and his horsemen, into the midst of the sea.

entries.title: Exodus 14:24
segments: And it came to pass in the morning watch, that Jehovah looked upon the camp of the Egyptians, in the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and embarrassed the camp of the Egyptians.

entries.title: Exodus 14:25
segments: And he took off their chariot wheels, and caused them to drive with difficulty; and the Egyptians said, Let us flee before Israel, for Jehovah is fighting for them against the Egyptians!

entries.title: Exodus 14:26
segments: And Jehovah said to Moses, Stretch out thy hand over the sea, that the waters may return upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots and upon their horsemen.

entries.title: Exodus 14:27
segments: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength toward the morning; and the Egyptians fled against it; and Jehovah overturned the Egyptians into the midst of the sea.

entries.title: Exodus 14:28
segments: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots and the horsemen of all the host of Pharaoh that had come into the sea after them; there remained not even one of them.

entries.title: Exodus 14:29
segments: And the children of Israel walked on dry [ground] through the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

entries.title: Exodus 14:30
segments: Thus Jehovah saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the sea-shore.

entries.title: Exodus 14:31
segments: And Israel saw the great power [with] which Jehovah had wrought against the Egyptians; and the people feared Jehovah, and believed in Jehovah, and in Moses his bondman.
